blockers.criterion: AC 5 Setup Modal Interaction (spec 4.3.3): lists indexers with install/index badges; copyable install instructions when the binary is missing; Use <indexer> + Rebuild Index when indexed; Build Index when installed, unindexed and canBuild; graphify shows copyable '/graphify . in Claude Code' and disables direct build; loading state during build; ErrorBox plus <pre class="code mono"> output on failure; onConfigured() on success; role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-label="Code Search Setup", Escape/backdrop close, focus trap
blockers.reason: The file does not exist; no modal is implemented anywhere in web/ui/src (grep for 'Code Search', 'Setup Code Indexer', 'setupCodeSearch' only hits api.ts). Implement it with its per-indexer state logic in a plain web/ui/src module (e.g. a function mapping a CodeIndexerStatus to {badges, actions[{label, disabled, body}], copyText}) and test that module: missing binary -> Build/Use disabled and copy text = install command; installed+indexed graft -> 'Use graft' sends {indexer:'graft',build:false} and 'Rebuild Index' sends build:true; installed+unindexed graft -> 'Build Index' build:true; installed+unindexed graphify -> Build disabled, copy text contains '/graphify .', Configure button; busy state disables all actions; failure result exposes ApiError.output for the pre block.

A test (through a plain web/ui/src module the Doctor uses) must show the action is offered for {name:'code indexer', ok:false} and not for ok:true or other check names, and that a successful setup result's checks replace the displayed checks (code indexer ok:true).

blockers.criterion: AC 6 Selector integrity + AGENTS.md rule: a UI markup change updates the tool's SELECTORS and functions in the same PR
blockers.reason: No selectors/helpers were added for the setup dialog, indexer cards, actions or build feedback (plan section 4). Once the modal exists, test/ui-automation.test.ts must cover the new selectors existing in web/ui/src.

blockers.criterion: Spec 6.3: nonzero exit returns { ok:false, error: "<command> exited with code <N>", output }
blockers.reason: Line ~411 returns 'indexer exited with code N' instead of naming the command (e.g. 'graft build exited with code 7'). When the child is killed by a signal without a timeout, code is null and the message reads 'indexer exited with code null'. The existing test only matches /7/. A test should assert error === 'graft build exited with code 7' for a fake graft that sets exitCode 7, and that a child killed by SIGKILL (not timeout) gets a message naming the signal rather than 'code null'.

blockers.criterion: Spec 4.2.2 / 6.6 concurrent requests: a build must not overlap another build for the same project
blockers.reason: On timeout runBuild resolves immediately after sending SIGTERM (finish() inside the timer) and the route's finally releases inFlightBuilds while the child may still be running (it ignores SIGTERM until the unref'd 500 ms SIGKILL). A second POST {build:true} in that window spawns a second indexer writing the same index. A test with a child that ignores SIGTERM should fire the deadline, then immediately POST a second build and expect a 400 'already in progress' (or the first response to wait until the child has exited).

blockers.criterion: Spec 5.1.4: setup failures return HTTP 400 { ok:false, error }
blockers.reason: The POST route reads sdlc.config.json with an unguarded fs.readFileSync (unlike the GET route), so an unreadable config (e.g. a directory named sdlc.config.json, or mode 000) throws out of the handler instead of returning { ok:false, error } with 400. A test should make sdlc.config.json a directory and expect status 400 with ok:false and a message naming the file.
